data.name: Cosmina
data.gender_notes: Cosmina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman name COSSIMUS, meaning 'helpful', 'assistance'. The feminine variant, COSMINA, symbolizes divine assistance and God's mercy and favor. The name Cosmina carries the meaning “God's mercy, favor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cosmina usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mercy, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine help and God's mercy
data.etymology: Cosmina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's mercy, favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cosmina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_greek.name: Κοσμίνα
in_greek.meaning: Βασιλεύς της ομορφιάς, σοφία, δύναμη, ψηφίσματα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα Κοσμίνα (Κοσμίνα) - Διάκριση με την όμορφη σοφία, δύναμη και ψηφίσματα. Η Κοσμίνα είναι ονομασία που έχει την πηγή της στην κοσμολογία, σοφία, και την εξέλιξη της ομορφιάς. Η Κοσμίνα είναι επίσης η απεικόνιση της κοσμοθεατρικής σκέψης, που συνδυάζει την σοφία, την ομορφιά και την δύναμη. Η Κοσμίνα ήταν και είναι το όνομα πολλών αξιωματικών της Ορθόδοξης Εκκλησίας

in_latin.name: Cosmina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cosmina - Differentia cum pulchritudine sapientia, potestas et decreta. Cosmina est nomen quod originem habet in cosmologia, sapientia et evolutione pulchritudinis. Cosmina est etiam repraesentatio cosmicae cogitationis, quae sapientiam, pulchritudinem et potentiam coniungit. Cosmina erat et est nomen plurium dignitatum Ecclesiae Orthodoxae

in_english.name: Cosmina
in_english.meaning: Queen of beauty, wisdom, power, and decrees
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cosmina - Distinguishing feature of beauty, wisdom, power, and decrees. Cosmina is a name that has its roots in cosmology, wisdom, and the evolution of beauty. Cosmina is also a representation of cosmic thinking, which combines wisdom, beauty, and power. Cosmina was and is the name of many dignitaries of the Orthodox Church
